// diagnostic

E0988

This uses a retired loop-label or dot-exit form.

What

This uses a retired loop-label or dot-exit form.

Why

Named exits are keyword-led: `break(name)`, `break(name, value)`, and `next(name)`. A loop name is not a runtime object.

Fix

Replace the dot or `@` form with the matching target-argument exit. Keep the declaration as `name :: loop`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0988: tests/ui/loop_label_value_position.stderr.

Error [E0988]: Loop label `outer` is not a runtime value
  --> tests/ui/loop_label_value_position.jet:7:17
    |
  7 |         consume(outer)
    |                 ^^^^^
 Why: A loop label names a control-flow destination, so it cannot be read, passed, or stored
 Fix: Use `break(outer)` or `next(outer)` to control the loop
